body:
Reviewed the whole interface, the component system and motion against the goal of a restrained minimalism; no application code changed.

Tokens are followed almost everywhere. Open for the owner: nine visible defects (for example "Do Sprawdzenia" column titles and a clipped focus ring on Wybierz daty), slow layered entrances, two card and two board styles, ISO dates in a monospace face, and duplicated controls in several views. Which of these to act on is the owner's choice. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-ui-review.md.

metadata.summary: Visual review of the interface completed
